storage: Airtight container in a cool, dry place; in monsoon, refrigerate.
looksLike: A very fine, soft, bright white powder from raw milled rice; it feels dry and slightly squeaky between the fingers.
howToPick: Bright white, fine, free of lumps and with no sour or musty smell; check the packing date.
shelfLife: About 3 to 4 months sealed (general guidance, not taken from a source in this run); it can turn rancid or get weevils sooner in humid months.

usedIn.raw: 3 g rice flour per serving (about 1 tsp, in the vada batter)
